pages.title: A blue line · 1/3
paragraphs: It is two in the afternoon on a sunny street in San Francisco. Theo and Mia stand at a corner with a phone. They want to go to a big park for a picnic. The map app shows a blue line on the screen. Next to it, small numbers show minutes and miles. They study the options together.
“Mia, how long does it take to walk to the park?” says Theo. “Let me check the app. It says twenty-five minutes.” says Mia. “That is long. How far is it?” says Theo.
